data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant gross reserve strengthening of $833.86 million for prior underwriting years, primarily driven by adverse development on the 2015, 2016, and 2017 underwriting years, partially offset by releases on the 2018 underwriting year. The report also notes that the MGA Insurance segment in the current year was impacted by claims from COVID-19 and an above-average year for natural catastrophe claims, including multiple landfalling hurricanes in the United States. General risk factors affecting reserve reliability include claim costs, handling costs, inflation, regulatory changes, and economic conditions.
